facts.fact: Banks and telecom operators verify people against the national ID through NINAuth, with 153 million SIM cards now linked to National Identification Numbers, says NIMC's head of Software and Biometrics.
NINAuth is used for remote bank customer verification and for telecom SIM registration, two sectors, says NIMC's head of Software and Biometrics.
NINAuth processes 1.3 million verification requests daily and 153 million SIM cards are linked to National Identification Numbers, says NIMC's head of Software and Biometrics.
